Regarding advanced features, the team discussed demonstrating an 'advanced' help guide and planning to show an 'advanced+' feature specifically for campaigns after the holidays. Separately, there was a request for receipts and invoices related to expenses from various team members.
decisions: The advanced+ campaign feature will be demonstrated after the holidays.
